title: Cover matters: enhanced performance of a multistage solar evaporator with tuned optical and thermal cover properties
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE02710H, Paper
Shiteng Li, Shang Liu, Qijun Yang, Shuai Deng, Meng Lin
Designs and operating spaces were explored where silica aerogel covers could be substituted with film (n = 1, 1 sun) or acrylic (n = 10, 3 suns) covers, which are cost-effective, durable materials that do not compromise the performance of the multistage solar evaporator device.
